title: Time for a better LinkedIn headline ✍️ #linkedinprofile
description:
Your LinkedIn headline is one of the first places a receuiter is going to look when they land on your profile…but what if you are a recent graduate and don’t have a lot of experience to put there? There’s three things to keep in mind:

1) Use keywords from your target industry

2) Don’t put “aspiring” before your target title

3) Use achievements from past jobs, internships and activities filling the 220 characters with only good information.
 #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips
